name: paperwork
description: Teaches the agent that this sandbox has a `paperwork` CLI for documents, reading a PDF's text layer, OCRing a scan or a photographed receipt, converting between PDF/docx/odt/epub/markdown, and merging or splitting PDFs, and, above all, which of those two PDF paths a given file actually needs. Ships the `paperwork` skill; the CLI itself arrives on PATH from the same extension.
